result.stdout:
USAGE:
    create-guid [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

OPTIONS:
                                         DEFAULT                                
    -h, --help                                      Prints help information     
    -v, --verbosity <VERBOSITY-LEVEL>    Normal     The verbosity level for this
                                                    operation: q(uiet),         
                                                    m(inimal), n(ormal),        
                                                    d(etailed), and diag(nostic)
    -c, --count <COUNT>                  1          The number of GUIDs to      
                                                    generate (defaults to 1)    
    -f, --format <GUID-FORMAT>           Default    Defines how the GUIDs are   
                                                    formatted in string form    
                                                    (Default, Number, Braces,   
                                                    Parens, Hex)                
    -s, --uuid-v7                                   Generates a UUID v7         
                                                    compliant GUID for sortable 
                                                    unique identifiers          
    -e, --empty                                     Defines if the GUIDs should 
                                                    be empty (using zero-values)
    -u, --upper                                     Defines if the generated    
                                                    GUIDs should be upper-cased 
                                                    (defaults to lower-cased)   
    -p, --clipboard-copy                            Defines whether the output  
                                                    of this command should be   
                                                    copied to the system        
                                                    clipboard                   
    -o, --output                                    Filename for output file    
                                                    used to save generated guids

COMMANDS:
    generate    Default command that generates GUIDs in the appropriate format
